reviews.title: Not “all stores” as promoted
reviews.text: I tried to add Crateandbarrel and other stores and it doesn’t let me add simply because it’s not one the partners.

reviews.title: I am not happy.
reviews.text: I tried to get my son a cash fund going for his birthday so I stupidly used this app. The app is simple, but I had to click and go through the SAME process over and over again. It’s frustrating. Then, I reached out to their “chat service” which was not helpful either. I called up, left a message and nothing happened. I’m very unhappy and now I don’t know where the funds are. If I could add a picture of what I’m angry about I would but of course I can’t.

reviews.title: doesn’t fill in the info for you anymore
reviews.text: I still love this app but it’s frustrating that it never captures photos/ descriptions/ price anymore from certain websites like Amazon.

reviews.title: Find a list
reviews.text: Last update has deleted find a gift list.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Using this on an older phone and with the new updates I am forced to use a different app and website as I cannot upload without the “new version” in stores. There is no ability to bypass the update and stay in an older version. This has been my go to for years with my kids, disappointed to move to another company.
